question: What mantra and power are to be placed at the tip of the nose?
premises: The power of wisdom is specified.
The mantra to Nātibhava ends with obeisance.
The placement is at the tip of the nose.
inference: One should place wisdom and the Nātibhava mantra ending with obeisance at the tip of the nose.
plain_english: One should place wisdom and the mantra to Nātibhava ending with obeisance at the tip of the nose.
